detail: withAgentAApiBudget (scripts/agent-a-api-budget.mjs, pre-fix) threw before any network call because it required max_output_tokens === 800 exactly, while this task's own contract requires >= 1600 for a two-round tool loop. Fixed in the same session by replacing the exact-equality check with resolveMaxOutputTokensCeilingV1 (default 1600, configurable ceiling) and by reserving budget from body.max_output_tokens instead of a hard-coded 800.

note: budget wrapper fix applied; request now reaches the network, but the TOOLS shape in Step 5 nested the function schema (Chat Completions style: {type,function:{name,...}}) instead of the flat Responses API shape DeepSeek expects.
